questions.stem: What is a major disadvantage of renewable energy sources like solar and wind power?

options.text: They produce large amounts of CO2
They are intermittent and depend on weather conditions, requiring energy storage solutions

questions.explanation: Solar and wind energy are intermittent, meaning they only generate electricity when the sun shines or the wind blows. This creates challenges for meeting constant energy demand. Energy storage solutions (batteries, pumped hydro) and grid infrastructure improvements are needed to manage this variability during the transition from fossil fuels.
